items.source: Returns the default IsNewStrategy to be used. Will be a PersistentEntityIsNewStrategy by default. Note, that this strategy only gets used if the entity doesn't implement Persistable as this indicates the user wants to be in control over whether an entity is new or not.

getInstanceCreatorMetadata in interface PersistentEntity<T, P extends PersistentProperty<P>>

null in case no suitable creation mechanism for automatic construction can be found. This usually indicates that the instantiation of the object of that persistent entity is done through either a customer EntityInstantiator or handled by custom conversion mechanisms entirely.
